content: For a single-instance Express app, a setInterval started from server.js is sufficient for periodic jobs (email queue drain, voting deadline close); node-cron adds cron syntax but no durability; either way jobs must be idempotent, skip re-entrant runs, and be safe if the process restarts mid-run. External search unavailable (BRAVE_API_KEY not set) — MEDIUM-confidence general Node practice, corroborated in-repo by CONCERNS.md recommending setInterval every 5 min for closeExpired.
